rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# libtoolize must not run, it would replace the files of these sources with # those of the installed libtool. LIBTOOLIZE="true" autoreconf -vfi bh_autotools_dev_update
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ GREP="grep" \ SED="sed"
